attchmntText: Hisar Metal Industries Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Hisar Metal Industries Limited approved the unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The Board of Directors held its meeting on November 14, 2026. The results were subjected to a limited review by the statutory auditors. The financial statements were prepared in accordance with Indian Accounting Standards. The standalone and consolidated results are enclosed with the announcement. The meeting commenced at 10.15 a.m. and concluded at 12.05 p.m. The company is listed on the Bombay Stock Exchange and the National Stock Exchange of India Limited. The registered office is located in Hisar, Haryana. The company secretary signed the communication on behalf of the board.
